metadata.title: Advanced Rename and Delete Handler
metadata.description: Advanced Rename and Delete Handler Localization & Tweaks
metadata.author: Nick617

ast.name: appendText
ast.source: Installed, and doing nothing yet: renames and deletions stay with Obsidian until you turn on
ast.target: 已安装，但尚未执行任何操作：重命名和删除操作仍由 Obsidian 处理，直到你开启

ast.name: appendText
ast.source: If you used an earlier version and never changed its settings, rename handling used to be on. Turn it back on to keep it.
ast.target: 如果你使用过早期版本且从未更改其设置，重命名处理以前是开启的。重新开启它以保留该功能。

ast.name: appendText
ast.source: Whether to handle renames and moves at all.
ast.target: 是否处理重命名和移动操作。

ast.name: appendText
ast.source: When enabled, this plugin updates the links pointing at a renamed or moved file, replacing Obsidian's own link update.
ast.target: 启用后，此插件会更新指向已重命名或已移动文件的链接，替代 Obsidian 自带的链接更新功能。

ast.name: appendText
ast.source: When disabled, Obsidian updates the links on its own, and file name aliases are left as they are. Moving and renaming attachments are separate switches below, and work either way.
ast.target: 禁用时，Obsidian 会自行更新链接，文件名别名保持不变。移动和重命名附件是下方的独立开关，两种情况下均可使用。

ast.name: appendText
ast.source: Off by default, like everything else here: installing this plugin changes nothing until you turn something on.
ast.target: 默认关闭，与此处的其他功能一样：安装此插件不会改变任何东西，直到你开启某项功能。

ast.name: appendText
ast.source: Whether an attachment that collides with an existing file at the destination replaces it.
ast.target: 当附件与目标位置已有文件冲突时，是否替换该文件。

ast.name: appendText
ast.source: ⚠️ This deletes the file already at the destination. When disabled, the moved attachment is renamed instead.
ast.target: ⚠️ 这会删除目标位置已有的文件。禁用时，被移动的附件将被重命名。

ast.name: appendText
ast.source: Whether deleting a note also deletes the attachments only that note referenced.
ast.target: 删除笔记时是否也删除仅该笔记引用的附件。

ast.name: appendText
ast.source: ⚠️ An attachment still referenced by another note is never deleted, but everything else the note owned is.
ast.target: ⚠️ 仍被其他笔记引用的附件永远不会被删除，但该笔记拥有的其他所有内容都会被删除。

ast.name: appendText
ast.source: Whether an attachment that survives a deletion, because another note still references it, is moved into that note's attachment folder.
ast.target: 因其他笔记仍引用而幸存的附件是否会被移动到该笔记的附件文件夹中。

ast.name: appendText
ast.source: When disabled, the attachment stays where the deleted note had put it.
ast.target: 禁用时，附件会留在被删除笔记放置它的位置。

ast.name: appendText
ast.source: Which note adopts an attachment several notes reference, highest priority first.
ast.target: 由哪个笔记接管多个笔记引用的附件，优先级从高到低。

ast.name: appendText
ast.source: Insert each entry on a new line. An entry is an extension such as
ast.target: 在新行中插入每个条目。条目是扩展名，例如

ast.name: appendText
ast.source: If the setting is empty, or two notes tie, the list settles nothing and the row below decides what happens.
ast.target: 如果设置为空，或两个笔记优先级相同，该列表无法决定，由下面的行决定结果。

ast.name: appendText
ast.source: What to do when the priority list above settles nothing — it is empty, nothing in it matches, or two notes tie.
ast.target: 当上面的优先级列表无法决定时该怎么办——它是空的、其中没有任何匹配项，或者两条笔记并列。

ast.name: appendText
ast.source: Ask shows the notes keeping the attachment alive, says why the list did not decide, and moves the attachment into whichever one you pick.
ast.target: Ask 会显示保持附件存活的笔记，说明列表为何未能决定，并将附件移动到你所选的笔记中。

ast.name: appendText
ast.source: Leave it in place keeps the attachment, and the folder holding it, exactly where they are.
ast.target: Leave it in place 会保留附件以及存放它的文件夹，保持它们原封不动。

ast.name: appendText
ast.source: Files matching these entries are attachments even though their extension says otherwise.
ast.target: 与这些条目匹配的文件即为附件，即使其扩展名表明并非如此。

ast.name: appendText
ast.source: , which is how Excalidraw marks a drawing stored as markdown.
ast.target: ，这是 Excalidraw 标记以 markdown 存储的绘图的方式。

ast.name: appendText
ast.source: A property entry matches a markdown file only once Obsidian has indexed it.
ast.target: 只有当 Obsidian 已为其建立索引后，属性条目才会匹配 markdown 文件。

ast.name: appendText
ast.source: Insert each path on a new line
ast.target: 将每个路径插入到新的一行

ast.name: appendText
ast.source: You can use path string or
ast.target: 你可以使用路径字符串或

ast.name: appendText
ast.source: If the setting is empty, the whole vault is handled.
ast.target: 如果设置为空，则处理整个仓库。

ast.name: appendText
ast.source: If the setting is empty, no paths are excluded.
ast.target: 如果设置为空，则不排除任何路径。

ast.name: error
ast.source: No Intl support, please use an Intl polyfill!
ast.target: 不支持 Intl，请使用 Intl polyfill！

ast.name: error
ast.source: Only canvas changes are supported for canvas files
ast.target: canvas 文件仅支持 canvas 更改

ast.name: error
ast.source: Node text is not a string

ast.name: setName
ast.source: Use the same answer for the rest of this deletion
ast.target: 对本次删除的其余部分使用相同答案

ast.name: setText
ast.target: 被多个笔记使用的附件

ast.name: setTooltip
ast.source: Reset to the current value, leaving this setting as it is
ast.target: 重置为当前值，保持此设置不变

ast.name: warn
ast.source: Instance method `debug.destroy()` is deprecated and no longer does anything. It will be removed in the next major version of `debug`.
ast.target: 实例方法 `debug.destroy()` 已弃用且不再执行任何操作。它将在 `debug` 的下一个主要版本中被移除。

ast.name: warn
ast.source: accessing an object - but returnObjects options is not enabled!
ast.target: 正在访问对象 - 但未启用 returnObjects 选项！

ast.name: warn
ast.source: Seems the loaded translations were in flat JSON format instead of nested. Either set keySeparator: false on init or make sure your translations are published in nested format.
ast.target: 似乎加载的翻译是扁平 JSON 格式而非嵌套格式。请在初始化时设置 keySeparator: false，或确保您的翻译以嵌套格式发布。

ast.name: warn
ast.source: This means something IS WRONG in your setup. You access the t function before i18next.init / i18next.loadNamespace / i18next.changeLanguage was done. Wait for the callback or Promise to resolve before accessing it!!!
ast.target: 这意味着你的配置中存在问题。你在 i18next.init / i18next.loadNamespace / i18next.changeLanguage 完成之前访问了 t 函数。请等待回调或 Promise 解析后再访问它！！！

ast.name: warn
ast.source: nesting options string contains interpolated variables with escapeValue: false — if any of those values are attacker-controlled they can inject additional nesting options (e.g. redirect lng/ns). Sanitise untrusted input before passing it to t(), or keep escapeValue: true.
ast.target: 嵌套选项字符串包含插值变量且 escapeValue: false —— 如果其中任何值受攻击者控制，他们可以注入额外的嵌套选项（例如重定向 lng/ns）。在将不受信任的输入传递给 t() 之前对其进行清理，或保持 escapeValue: true。

ast.name: warn
ast.source: No backend was added via i18next.use. Will not load resources.
ast.target: 未通过 i18next.use 添加后端。将不会加载资源。

ast.name: warn
ast.source: init: no languageDetector is used and no lng is defined
ast.target: init：未使用 languageDetector 且未定义 lng

ast.name: warn
ast.source: init: i18next is already initialized. You should call init just once!
ast.target: init：i18next 已初始化。你应该只调用一次 init！

ast.name: warn
ast.source: hasLoadedNamespace: i18n.languages were undefined or empty

ast.name: warn
ast.source: [remark-wiki-link] Warning: please upgrade to remark 13 to use this plugin
ast.target: [remark-wiki-link] 警告：请升级到 remark 13 以使用此插件

ast.name: desc
ast.source: These enabled plugins declare this one as a dependency. Disabling or uninstalling it stops them until it is back. Select one to open its settings.
ast.target: 这些已启用的插件将此项声明为依赖项。禁用或卸载它将导致这些插件停止工作，直到它恢复为止。选择一个以打开其设置。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: Whether renaming a note also rewrites the display text of the links that pointed at its old name.
ast.target: 重命名笔记时是否也重写指向其旧名称的链接的显示文本。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: Whether renaming a note also renames or moves its attachment folder alongside it.
ast.target: 重命名笔记时是否也重命名或移动其附件文件夹。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: Whether renaming a note also renames the attachment files that travel with it, so their names keep matching the note.
ast.target: 重命名笔记时是否也重命名随其移动的附件文件，以便它们的名称与笔记保持一致。

ast.name: desc
ast.source: What to do with a folder that a deletion or a move has left empty.
ast.target: 删除或移动操作导致文件夹为空时如何处理该文件夹。

ast.name: description
ast.target: 多值 frontmatter 外部链接

ast.target: 调试模式：故意占位符错误。请参阅 https://mnaoumov.dev/obsidian-dev-utils/guides/debugging/。

ast.name: name
ast.source: When several notes could adopt the attachment
ast.target: 当多个笔记可能采用该附件时

ast.name: text
ast.source: Each row shows what this plugin holds now and what is proposed. Edit a suggested value, or reset a row to keep the current one. Nothing is written until you press OK.
ast.target: 每一行显示此插件当前持有的内容以及建议的内容。编辑建议值，或将某行重置为保留当前值。在你按下确定之前，不会写入任何内容。

ast.name: text
ast.source: Pick the note that should adopt it, or leave it where it is.
ast.target: 选择应采用它的笔记，或将其保留在原处。
